key_findings: Intrathecal siRNA/shRNA knockdown of dynamin (Dnm1-3) or AAK1 in DRG neurons, or inhibitors of clathrin, dynamin and AAK1, reversed allodynia and hyperalgesia in CFA inflammatory and SNI neuropathic pain models without motor effects.
Dnm1 and AAK1 disruption suppressed presynaptic vesicle release from primary afferents onto lamina I/II neurons, and Dnm siRNA prevented sustained GPCR-mediated nociceptor sensitization.
